title: Journey Medical Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Journey Medical Corporation filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026 announcing expanded pharmacy benefit coverage for Emrosi, their modified-release minocycline capsule treatment for inflammatory lesions of rosacea in adults. The announcement is supported by a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1.
key_points: Journey Medical Corporation is an emerging growth company incorporated in Delaware with ticker DERM listed on Nasdaq Capital Market
Announced April 21, 2026: expansion in pharmacy benefit coverage for Emrosi (40 mg Minocycline Hydrochloride Modified-Release Capsules)
Emrosi is indicated for treatment of inflammatory lesions of rosacea in adults (10 mg immediate release and 30 mg extended release)
Filed under Item 8.01 Other Events and Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits
Signed by Claude Maraoui, Chief Executive Officer, President and Director
